SI LENGTH ghi 'median around 15' (lay tu chuong 1). Trung vi 30 chuong mau la 21, trung binh 25. Model con viet ngan hon ca 15 (10-14). Sua: bo con so 15, dung so cua 30 chuong, va them luat cam hai doan ngan lien tiep
Tac gia bac huong 'lay so do nhip lam cong chot SI': bo khoi LENGTH khoi writer/SI-template (v6), khong thay bang khoi so nao. Nhip do anchor va nguyen tac viet bang loi ganh
nguon: Tac gia 01/11: 'Con so dem la vo nghia trong van hoc. No chi khien Writer kem di thoi. Neu phan SI khac viet tot, Anchor dung thi khong can den khoi Length do.'
